title: Calculating Late-Delivery Compensation on Marketplace Orders
content:
**Calculation.** On Marketplace Orders, the late-delivery compensation is the shipping charge recorded on the order, booked in full as one late-delivery shipping refund and rounded half up to the cent; an order delivered on or before its promised delivery date, or whose shipping charge was zero, is owed nothing.

## Inputs and their records

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| shipping charge | the shipping charge recorded on the order at checkout |
| promised delivery date | the order record |
| delivered date | the order record (the date of the delivered scan) |

## Decision table

| Delivered date compared with the promised delivery date | Shipping charge recorded | Compensation |
|---|---|---|
| on or before | any | nothing |
| after | zero | nothing |
| after | above zero | the shipping charge, in full, rounded half up to the cent |

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

1. A hypothetical order with a recorded shipping charge of USD 9.99, promised for 14 May and delivered on 16 May. The delivery is after the promised date and the charge is above zero, so the compensation is USD 9.99, booked as one late-delivery shipping refund.
2. The same order delivered on 14 May: on the promised date, so nothing is owed.
3. A hypothetical order with a recorded shipping charge of USD 0.00, delivered three days late: nothing is owed.
